verses.pali: “Sanimittā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no animittā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with a basis, not without a basis.

verses.pali: Tasseva nimittassa pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that basis, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
